subject: PoC gating: hosting decision, success criteria & runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: PoC gating: hosting decision, success criteria & runbook

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the PoC and make a clean hosting decision (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC).

Call highlights (as we heard them):
- Primary driver: predictable latency for clinical inference (95th percentile target <= 300ms for short prompts).
- Data residency / PHI requirement: may require Private VPC if audit/scope expands.
- Expected peak QPS during PoC: ~8–12 concurrent infer requests (burst to 20).
- Cost sensitivity: target token cost envelope for proof-of-value period.

Proposed PoC gating & runbook (attached):
Phase 0 — Quick lab (1 week): smoke tests on Hosted API (validate latencies, basic KV cache behavior).
Phase 1 — Dedicated trial (2–3 weeks): reserved capacity to prove steady-state SLOs + realistic workload.
Phase 2 — Private VPC dry-run (2 weeks, optional): if compliance gating requires, mirror production network egress and audit logs.

Success criteria (we should confirm or modify):
- Latency: 95th <= 300ms for 256-token requests on the selected model variant.
- Throughput: sustained 10 qps for 1 minute windows without errors.
- Cost: projected per-1M tokens <= $X (we'll fill after we baseline).
- Observability: token-level traces + request-level audit logs visible in the Redwood Console.
- Security: SOC2 evidence + VPC peering checklist if Private requested.

Owners & asks:
- Medallion: confirm whether PHI will be in-scope for the PoC (Aisha).
- Medallion: provide sample request distribution (typical prompt lengths and QPS pattern).
- Redwood: we'll provide sprint plan, a Dedicated capacity quote, and SOC2 evidence.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm PHI scope and preferred sequence (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private, or skip Hosted).
2) We'll schedule a 30-min ops kickoff next week to share the sprint plan (I attached v1).
3) Provide sandbox token and test dataset pointer (Medallion).

Attached: redwood-poc-sprint-plan-v1.xlsx, redwood-poc-success-metrics.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-poc-runbook
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/15829

Thanks — looking forward to locking the sequence so we can budget time and nodes for Dedicated if you want to try that next.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference


From: Aisha Patel <aisha@medallionhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@medallionhealth.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 May 2025 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PoC gating: hosting decision, success criteria & runbook

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the tidy recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- PHI: likely yes — our clinical notes will be involved for intent extraction in the PoC. That pushes us to prefer Dedicated or Private, but we are open to a quick Hosted lab if you think it will surface perf issues faster.
- Compliance ask: can you send your SOC2 attestation + the VPC peering checklist? Our security team will need both before we greenlight Private.
- Timeline: we are aiming to show value to the clinical leadership in 6 weeks; ideally Phase 0+1 fit into that window.
- Success metrics: add a quality metric — automated F1 vs labeled dev set >= 0.85 for intent extraction.

A few operational constraints:
- We cannot provide production PHI during the PoC. We will provide a de-identified sample dataset first; can you confirm Redwood's support for a tokenized test dataset and a follow-up run against a synthetic-but-closer-to-prod set?
- Procurement: please include a short T&Cs summary and an estimated Dedicated monthly rate so our procurement can start reviewing.

If we can get SOC2 + Dedicated estimate + an ops kickoff by next Tue (6 May), we can keep the 6-week target.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
Medallion Health


From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC gating: hosting decision, success criteria & runbook

Aisha —

Appreciate the quick reply and the clarity on PHI. Notes below and commitments from Redwood: 

1) SOC2 & VPC checklist:
- I'll attach our SOC2 attestation snapshot and the VPC peering checklist in the packet for your security team. (attached: redwood-poc-success-metrics.pdf includes checklist index).

2) Dataset approach:
- Agreed: start with de-identified sample (Phase 0) and then a synthetic/anon-injected set for Phase 1. For the Private dry-run we can arrange a short window for a sanitized production-like test if procurement/security approves.

3) Quality metric added: we will include an F1 >= 0.85 target on your labeled dev set as a PoC pass/fail gate. We'll run evaluation scripts and share the eval notebook.

4) Timeline & ops kickoff:
- Ops kickoff: Tue, 6 May 2025 @ 10:00 AM ET (30 minutes). Please confirm attendees.
- Proposed PoC windows: Phase 0 (5–9 May), Phase 1 (12–30 May). This keeps us inside your 6-week ambition.

5) Commercials & estimate:
- Vivek will provide a Dedicated trial rate card and a short T&Cs summary by EOD Monday (5 May).

6) Sandbox access:
- To make Phase 0 efficient, can you provision a test endpoint and share sample request patterns (CSV)? If not, we can use the de-identified set you provide.

I've attached an updated sprint plan (redwood-poc-sprint-plan-v1.xlsx) with owners and tentative dates.

If that all looks good, I'll send a calendar invite for the ops kickoff with the pre-read pack.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference


From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: PoC gating — quick to-dos

Jordan —

Looping here with a short internal runbook for our side: 
- Vivek: prepare Dedicated trial rate + 6-week provisional capacity plan (include estimate for 2x headroom).
- I'll package SOC2 summary + VPC checklist, redact vendor contact info, and drop in the Drive link Jordan referenced.
- Jordan: once Aisha confirms attendees, I can join the kickoff to walk observability + tracing expectations.

Let's aim to have all docs in the Drive folder by EOD Mon so they can go to Medallion's security and procurement on Tue morning.

Thanks,
Grace
Head of Solutions Ops
Redwood Inference
